name: @aart/familiarity-evals
description: AART familiarity-evals: CI-gate suite that evaluates AART's own tool surface for model-nativeness — authoring-task fixtures run zero-shot against target models, scored deterministically via aart_validate output + run success (ADR-15; spec §32.4). A separate package from @aart/evidence's per-workflow eval system: the subject under test is AART's own API surface, not a user workflow.
